senses.gloss: (v. גפף) to make air-tight, to paste with gypsum, clay &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 10:5">Kel. X, 5</cite> <he>שגְּפָסָן עם וכ׳</he> Ar. a. R. H. G. (ed. <he>שגְּפָתָן</he>); <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 7:7">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. VII, 7</cite> <he>שגפסן</he> (Var. <he>שגפת׳</he>, R. S. to Kel. l. c. <he>שגְּפָפָן</he>) which one closed up by connecting the paste with the rim (leaving an empty space between the cover and the body of the vessel).

senses.gloss: to harden and be closely consolidated with the ground.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 4:3">Mikv. IV, 3</cite> Ar., Maim. a. Rabad (v. Tos’f. Yom Tob a. l.; ed. <cite ref="K00081"><he>נכבש</he></cite>).
